boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Validate changed-path parity and Git object identity at the named commit, then use the retained staged-review receipt for checkout-domain byte parity instead of equating checkout bytes with raw blob size.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Read hash_domain and checkout_bytes_domain before comparing sizes; never infer that the two byte domains are identical.
preferred_methods.rollback: Discard the false mismatch conclusion and retain the failed probe as an operational negative.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Source commit manifests and their retained staged-review receipts only; no source mutation and no independent-reproduction credit.
preferred_methods.title: Commit-manifest byte-domain discriminator
trigger_preconditions: A commit-local manifest declares checkout_bytes_domain separately from git_blob identity.
Later commits may have changed files that were present in an earlier staged manifest.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Retain every raw candidate, inspect the matching source line, and classify only pattern-definition lines in the scanner itself as scanner-definition candidates rather than confirmed artifact leaks.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Report candidate and confirmed-hit counts separately; never discard scanner self-matches without exact line-context classification.
preferred_methods.rollback: Restore fail-closed classification if a candidate is outside an exact scanner-definition line.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Exact staged scanner-definition lines only; zero confirmed hits is not complete privacy assurance.
preferred_methods.title: Scanner-definition candidate discriminator
trigger_preconditions: A scanner source file is included in the exact staged-file domain.
The source contains the literal patterns it is designed to detect.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Read the exact bounded current snippet, patch source-of-truth code first, then patch or regenerate the artifact with minimal exact context.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect generated key order before patching and avoid broad multi-file contexts that depend on inferred serialization order.
preferred_methods.rollback: No rollback is needed when apply_patch reports zero changes; retain the failed patch witness.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Owned x1 source and generated JSON only; no destructive rewrite.
preferred_methods.title: Generated-JSON narrow patch recovery
trigger_preconditions: A generated JSON artifact uses deterministic sorted keys.
The proposed patch context was inferred rather than read from the current file.
